LESSON.CANDIDATE_CAPABILITY: Detect strongly connected components in the prerequisite graph, identify externally qualified bootstrap candidates, and generate a minimal authority-preserving strategy to break the cycle.
LESSON.COUNTEREVIDENCE: The cycle is demonstrated in the current strategy, not necessarily in every possible implementation. Existing OS facilities may provide a bootstrap mechanism. No Planner capability has been implemented or measured efficiency improvement established.
LESSON.FAILURE_MODE: Circular qualification prerequisites prevent readiness promotion despite completed static implementations and evidence.
LESSON.OBSERVATION: The H77-02 qualification strategy requires host-enforcement evidence to qualify the single-use gate, while host-enforcement testing requires independently qualified single-use launch control.
LESSON.ROOT_CAUSE_HYPOTHESIS: Qualification strategy may fail to distinguish a selected implementation dependency from the actual single-use safety obligation and its independent bootstrap roots. No causal Planner deficiency is proven.
LESSON.VALIDATION_TEST: Provide a typed cycle with an acyclic authority lifecycle, independent and circular bootstrap alternatives, and unqualified candidate evidence. Require SCC detection, authority-preserving alternative selection and refusal to mark design-only candidates qualified; compare against a genuinely acyclic qualification sequence.
